## Interpretation

The exact high-v2 mass tail is already discharged.  This diagnostic asks
whether fixed low-v2 phases decay individually or whether a slow phase
needs a new state coordinate.  A proof route would explain these phase
fits by a finite dependency-depth or residue-period cancellation lemma.
